title: Public publishing training, review and removal need sponsor evidence
remediation: The sponsor public communications and information owners identify authorized publishers and train them to keep specified information out of public content. Sample a periodic review and a removal or controlled exercise if information is discovered. Record deployment scope for ITSP.10.171 and submit any no-public-content boundary for review.

milestones.title: Collect a publisher training record, recent public content review and a documented removal procedure with case or exercise evidence
